fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Warm and mostly dry conditions highlight the forecast through Friday. Localized critical fire weather conditions are expected Wednesday and Thursday afternoons due to gusty winds and low RH. Wind gusts up to 30 mph are likely area wide this weekend, but an influx of moisture will negate the potential for widespread critical fire weather conditions. ...GUSTY ERRATIC WINDS CAN BE EXPEC
